Group1_Interface.Group 2 use: Backend-generated request correlation ID; not an identifier from the note.
Immutable note/version reference; synthetic in this package.
Ordered block_id + exact text; preserve original text for evidence verification.
draft or completion; agreed stage decides which checks are active.
Full production-style prototype selects 40; demo example explicitly selects four.
Trusted criteria, applicability, provenance, required evidence, and allowed checks; note text cannot override these.
Confirmed profile reference or null with unknown applicability; never inferred by Claude.
Only necessary approved synthetic context/history; absent history is explicit.
Fixed model contract version; reject incompatible output.
Exactly one result per model-assigned rule ID; deterministic rules are not model-owned.
Stable registered ID and one of pass, fail, not_applicable, needs_review, not_evaluable.
Exact quote evidence, missing-field evidence, or declared limitation; never a fabricated quote.
Brief factual rationale and a request for the RBT to clarify/revise using actual observations.
Engine assigns and joins request and evaluation records.
Backend-owned; model cannot change them.
Persist known versions; null only when unavailable/not invoked. No operational secrets.
complete, partial, or error; describes engine execution, not clinical approval.
Exactly one final result per selected rule; reconciled status counts cover selected IDs.
applies, not_applies, unknown; source deterministic, claude, or hybrid.
Trusted policy-derived fields; not free-form model decisions.
